title: OpenCode project configuration
description: Validates opencode.json at the workspace root, the OpenCode counterpart of .claude/settings.json. Human-authored: no schemaVersion, kind or provenance because OpenCode reads this file directly. Closed at the top level to the keys Maxwell uses; agent, command, mcp, formatter and lsp maps are closed per entry. Secret-shaped values are refused: MCP environment values and credential-bearing headers must be '{env:NAME}' references. default_agent cannot be cross-checked against the agent map in JSON Schema; validate-frontmatter.mjs is the place for that

maxwell.description: Primary Maxwell operator: runs /<workflow> <company_id> and coordinates the specialist subagents

iac-auditor.description: Static probe of Terraform, Pulumi and Kubernetes manifests for a target application; read-only against target systems

validate.description: Run every Maxwell validator and report problems by path
validate.template: Run `npm run validate` and report every problem by path. Do not edit schemas. $ARGUMENTS

status.description: Summarise the ledger, open initiatives and pending suggestions for a company
status.template: Summarise the state of company-profile/$1: open findings by severity, initiatives in flight and pending suggestions

$schema.description: Must be the OpenCode config schema URL so OpenCode and editors recognise the file

instructions.description: Files or globs whose content is prepended to the system prompt. Maxwell always lists AGENTS.md first

default_agent.description: Name of the primary agent selected on startup; must be a key of agent with mode primary or all (checked by validate-frontmatter.mjs, not here)

agent.description: Agent definitions keyed by name. Maxwell subagents mirror .claude/agents; built-in OpenCode agents (build, plan, general) may be overridden or disabled here

command.description: Slash commands keyed by name; equivalent to .agents/commands/<name>.md files. Names must not collide with the 25 workflow scripts in .claude/workflows (the utility commands validate, kpis, status and seed-company are commands, not scripts)

plugin.description: Plugins to load: npm package specifiers or workspace-relative paths to plugin modules such as the Maxwell hook adapter

permission.description: Global tool permissions applied to every agent unless the agent overrides them

mcp.description: MCP servers keyed by name. Capped at 16 because every server adds tools to the context of every agent

model.description: Default model as provider/model, e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-5

small_model.description: Cheaper model used for titles, summaries and other low-stakes calls

share.description: Session sharing policy. Maxwell requires disabled: transcripts contain client infrastructure details

autoupdate.description: Whether OpenCode updates itself on startup; keep false for reproducible audit runs

snapshot.description: Whether OpenCode snapshots the working tree before edits so changes can be reverted

formatter.description: Code formatters keyed by name, or disabled per formatter. Capped at 16

lsp.description: Language servers keyed by language id, or disabled per server. Capped at 16

experimental.description: Raw passthrough of OpenCode experimental flags whose shape changes between releases; capped at 16 keys so it cannot become a dumping ground

agentName.description: Lower-case kebab-case identifier used for agents, commands, MCP servers and formatters

modelId.description: OpenCode model reference in provider/model form; the model part may itself contain slashes for router providers, e.g. openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4

envRef.description: OpenCode environment reference '{env:NAME}'; the only form allowed where a secret could otherwise be written

permissionMap.description: Tool name to action. Keys are the documented OpenCode tools (read, edit, glob, grep, bash, task, skill, lsp, question, webfetch, websearch, external_directory, doom_loop, and the write/patch/list/todowrite/todoread names the mirror emits), the global wildcard '*', or an MCP glob 'servername_*'. bash, edit and skill may instead map command or path patterns to actions; the most specific pattern wins and '*' is the default

agentConfig.description: One agent entry. description and mode are required unless the entry only disables a built-in (disable true)

description.description: What the agent does and when the primary agent should delegate to it

mode.description: primary agents are user-selectable, subagents are only invoked by other agents, all means both

model.description: Model override for this agent as provider/model

prompt.description: System prompt text, or '{file:./path}' to load it from a file such as the mirrored agent prompt

permission.description: Tool permissions for this agent, overriding the global permission map

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; Maxwell probes and auditors use 0 for reproducibility

disable.description: When true the agent is hidden and cannot be invoked; used to switch off OpenCode built-ins

description.description: One-line help shown in the command palette

template.description: Prompt sent when the command runs; $ARGUMENTS and $1..$n are substituted exactly as in Claude Code

agent.description: Agent that executes the command; defaults to the current primary agent

model.description: Model override for this command as provider/model

subtask.description: When true the command runs as a subtask in a fresh context instead of the current session

mcpServer.description: One MCP server. type local spawns command (optionally in cwd); type remote connects to url (optionally with oauth)

command.description: Executable and arguments for a local server

cwd.description: Workspace-relative working directory for a local server process

oauth.description: OAuth settings for a remote server: false disables OAuth entirely; otherwise a closed object whose clientSecret must be an '{env:NAME}' reference

enabled.description: Whether the server is started; false keeps the entry for documentation without exposing its tools

environment.description: Environment variables for a local server; every value must be an '{env:NAME}' reference, never a literal, so no secret can be committed here

headers.description: HTTP headers for a remote server. Any header whose name contains auth, api-key/apikey, token, secret or cookie (case-insensitive) must be an '{env:NAME}' reference; other headers may carry a short literal such as a content type

disabled.description: Set true to switch off a built-in formatter

command.description: Formatter executable and arguments; $FILE is substituted

environment.description: Environment variables for the formatter process

extensions.description: File extensions (with leading dot) the formatter handles

disabled.description: Set true to switch off a built-in language server

extensions.description: File extensions (with leading dot) routed to this server

env.description: Environment variables for the server process

initialization.description: Raw LSP initializationOptions passed through to the server; capped at 32 keys because its shape is server-specific
